digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 LLM orchestration and batch result instrumentation
propositions: Pass-1 pass functions discard per-call usage emitted by runner.run, leaving BatchRunResult.outputs without _usage and coverage.metrics without token totals for the most expensive pass
Per-criterion request counts are extracted but never persisted, blocking data-driven criterion demotion decisions

The three pass functions (pass1_chunk, pass1_container, pass1_isf) must change return type from list[dict] to (list[dict], dict) to thread usage through the call chain with all external callers atomically updated
Pass-1 and prerequisite call usage must be aggregated with multi-criterion chunks dividing token fields equally across criteria while requests and llm_calls count in full per criterion
The sidecar payload must expose coverage.usage with per_call records and per_criterion attribution to enable observability and data-driven optimization
